style.styleTitle: Homcom 6ft Artificial Fir Christmas Tree with 716 Tips
style.toneOfVoice: Holiday decorating can feel rushed when a sparse tree looks flat and setup steals your evening. This HOMCOM 6 ft Christmas tree transforms the mood with 716 branch tips, PE, PVC, and pine needle foliage for a full, lifelike appearance, while 63 white berries and 63 large berry ornaments add festive charm. A 3-section hinged trunk with auto-expand branches speeds up setup, helping your living room look beautifully decorated sooner. . 716 branch tips create a full, natural-looking Christmas tree with 63 white berries and 63 large berry ornaments; . Mixed PE, PVC, and pine needle foliage delivers a realistic look with lasting seasonal charm; . 3-section trunk with pre-attached hinged branches opens automatically for quick setup and shaping in 25–35 minutes; . Sectional design disassembles into a compact size for convenient off-season storage; . Branch tips provide added peace of mind throughout the holiday season; . Foldable metal base keeps the tree stable and upright while allowing compact storage after use; . Brings festive charm and a warm holiday atmosphere to any indoor space.
